```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(fuzzyjoin)
```

## Read and clean-up MRI Radiological Read data for ELGAN3 subjects

```{r read data}
base_path<-"/Volumes/LaCie/Projects/elgan_dti/data"

# Read MRI radiological reports and add to subs
mri<-read.csv(file.path(base_path, "demog_beh", "MRI083126.csv")) %>%
  select(-c("MRIReadDate", "age_mri", "MRISite", "MRIAgrOrCon", "SESPrCMarSta", "SESUseMedSta", "SESIncFodStm"))
  colnames(mri)[1]<-"sid"

```

## Count abnormal MRI findings

```{r count}
# Create a new variable to indicate whether ANY abnormalities were indicated

## first, reindex variables graded as 1=none, 2=mild, etc. to 0=none/mild, 1=moderate,severe:

mri <- mri %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(MRICSFVSLVRi, MRICSFVSLVLe, MRICSFVS3rdV, MRICSFVS4thV,
      MRICSFSSACRi, MRICSFSSACLe, MRICSFSSPCRi, MRICSFSSPCLe,
      MRICSFSSPFRi, MRICSFSSPFLe),
    ~ case_when(
      .x == 0        ~ NA_real_,
      .x %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0,
      .x > 2          ~ 1,
      TRUE            ~ .x
    )
  ))

## then create new variable where any value greater than 1 across the row results in 1 for 'abnormality'

mri <- mri %>%
  mutate(
    mri_abnorm_any = as.integer(
      rowSums(across(-sid) > 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    )
  )

## Check N with any abnormality
sum(mri$mri_abnorm_any)

## Save dataframe with summary output
write.csv(mri, "/Volumes/LaCie/Projects/elgan_dti/data/demog_beh/MRI083126_summaryVar.csv", row.names=FALSE)


```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
